_why: BAM GTA's trial_followup automation, deleted from prod 2026-07-27 with Zoran's approval, as part of making GTA look as if it had been created from the template. Captured here first so the delete is reversible.
_why_deleted: A duplicate of trial_form: same trigger (trial form filled, no time picked), same 20-minute wait, same message. trial_form has enrolled 30 leads including that same day; this had enrolled ZERO, ever, and was both disabled and never approved. It also referenced {{next_session}}, which nothing resolves, so had it ever sent, a parent would have read the literal characters.

steps.body: Hey {{contact.first_name}}, it's coach from BAM GTA! I noticed you filled in a trial form but didn't book a time. Can I help you find one that works? {{next_session}}Grab a spot here: byanymeanstoronto.ca/free-trial
